body: claimed: Codex (len) · 2026-11-18 11:45 UTC · branch mkinney:issue/2372-release-heavy-first · plan: count failed lanes and run heavy release tests before debug suites.

I read the available cut and failed post-merge gate artifacts on 2026-11-18. I counted each FAIL row once in each gate summary. A red step can contain several failed tests. These are step counts, not separate defect counts.

For cut.yml, GitHub lists six gate runs and three tag runs. Five gate runs completed. One gate run was cancelled. The five completed gate summaries contain two red steps:

| Run | Result | Red step count | Red step |
|---|---|---:|---|
| [43739171721](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43739171721) | failure | 1 | app heavy: pocket3d_hsm |
| [43746559176](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43746559176) | success | 0 | none |
| [43848762891](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43848762891) | success | 0 | none |
| [44127297984](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/44127297984) | failure | 1 | app heavy: pocket3d_hsm |
| [44148337620](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/44148337620) | success | 0 | none |

Both red steps failed the test `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`. Their gate runs took 66.4 and 91.1 minutes. The artifacts do not show a red motion heavy step in these runs. This corrects the issue body. The cancelled run 44122415904 has no final gate summary. The tag runs do not run the gate again.

For post-merge.yml, GitHub lists 50 failed runs from 2026-11-14 through 2026-11-18 10:30 UTC. I read all their available gate artifacts. Forty-nine runs have a complete gate summary for at least one attempt. They contain 271 red steps. The batch tier has no heavy steps.

One run, [43990986558](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43990986558), contains 199 red steps. Of these, 194 step logs directly report a missing assets/posts or assets/machines folder. These are a shared asset lookup failure. Five other red steps in that run do not contain that diagnostic. I kept those five in the other-results column.

| Lane family | All red steps | Direct asset folder errors | Other red results |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| app suites | 226 | 191 | 35 |
| ui suites | 22 | 2 | 20 |
| debug build | 7 | 0 | 7 |
| clippy -D warnings | 7 | 0 | 7 |
| motion suites | 5 | 0 | 5 |
| kernel suites | 2 | 0 | 2 |
| cl suites | 1 | 0 | 1 |
| post suites | 1 | 1 | 0 |

The repeated exact step names outside the direct asset folder errors are:

| Step name | Red count |
|---|---:|
| app suites (slow, release tier: center_cut_multiaxis) | 19 |
| ui suites (cwd crates/ui) | 10 |
| ui suites: lib | 9 |
| debug build (--no-run) | 7 |
| clippy -D warnings | 7 |
| app suites: microarc_test_part | 4 |
| app suites: stock_source_holes | 3 |
| motion suites: corner_arc_radius | 3 |
| kernel suites | 2 |

Older gates grouped all app suites or all UI suites in one step. Newer gates use one step per test binary. Thus these counts cannot measure the failure probability of each suite. Repeated runs of one unresolved defect also add repeated red results.

Limits: run 43634597083 failed during checkout and has no gate artifact. Run 43620716239 attempt 1 has four red gate steps. Its attempt 2 failed in sccache before xtask started and has no gate summary. I counted the four attempt 1 rows only. The cancelled cut has no final summary. These missing summaries do not add named lane failures.

Decision: run the release heavy steps after the two builds and before the debug suites. Both completed red cut runs failed there. Keep the existing isolation rules and duration order within each queue. The post-merge counts do not establish that heavy steps fail most often overall.
